video_title: The Celtics are ‘SHOPPING’ Jalen Brown to 8-10 TEAMS!😱 Shams Charania details... | First Take

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics are actively shopping Jaylen Brown to multiple NBA teams
quotes.excerpt: the Celtics have actually started strongly shopping Jaylen Brown, soliciting offers from a market of about 8-10 teams
quotes.quote: The Celtics have actually started strongly shopping Jaylen Brown, soliciting offers from a market of about 8-10 teams in the last several days. It's unclear whether a deal is close or where they necessarily stand, but there's been a high price threshold that the Celtics have set from the outset of any type of a Jaylen Brown trade. We know a couple weeks ago, they offered Jaylen Brown and two first-round picks for Giannis Antetokounmpo. So clearly, they would be willing to move him for a premium player.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics have decided to move on from Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: they've decided that they're trading Jaylen Brown and they just decided to offer him for Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.quote: What we've come to understand was the Celtics weren't trying to get Giannis Antetokounmpo and realizing, boy, we have to give Jaylen Brown to get him. They've decided that they're trading Jaylen Brown and they just decided to offer him for Giannis Antetokounmpo. You got to focus on the other way. They've decided they're done with him. And so, no, I don't think they're going to keep him. I think they're going to do everything they possibly can to trade him, and that's what their actions are showing here.

quotes.speaker: David Dennis Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Brad Stevens has mishandled the Jaylen Brown trade situation
quotes.excerpt: probably the biggest mistake of his tenure in the way that he's mishandled this off-season
quotes.quote: We've got to look at this as one of the worst mistakes in his tenure, probably the biggest mistake of his tenure in the way that he's mishandled this off-season. There is a world in which he says, 'Hey, Jaylen Brown is one of our best players we've had, second best player we've had in my tenure, we love him, we just cannot afford him because of second apron and supermax things. Let's go find a deal.' Instead, they've allowed all of this whispering and questions about him and let all this stuff fester and lowered his stock.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics are overvaluing Jaylen Brown in trade negotiations
quotes.excerpt: the Celtics are treating Jaylen Brown as far as what they are asking for in return as if he is a Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.quote: The Celtics are treating Jaylen Brown as far as what they are asking for in return as if he is a Giannis Antetokounmpo. They are wanting that type of trade package. That clearly is not out there. There's also the Celtics telling teams, 'Hey, we will take Jaylen Brown to training camp.' The other teams are not calling their bluff and saying, 'Go ahead and do it.' It's not that teams aren't interested in Jaylen Brown. It's not that there isn't a market for Jaylen Brown. There isn't a market for Jaylen Brown at what the Celtics want in return for him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: He absolutely explained it with nuance, experience, and sourcing. It makes total sense to me. Good luck selling that to Jaylen, though, because I think no matter how this plays out, Jaylen is going to see this as nothing but an absolute insult on him.

text_blocks.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
text_blocks.text: There's pieces to this puzzle that we don't know and we won't know until this trade is done. We don't have all the information in front of us. It's just a matter of, do you trust the Boston Celtics? Do you trust Brad Stevens because they know Jaylen Brown better than they know everybody else.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown will view the trade rumors as an insult
quotes.excerpt: I think no matter how this plays out, Jaylen is going to see this as nothing but an absolute insult on him.
